def register_artifact(
    name: str,
    type: str,
    description: str,
    project: str | None = None,
    exp_id: str | None = None,
    source_path: str | None = None,
    content: str | None = None,
    content_filename: str | None = None,
    url: str | None = None,
    tags: list[str] | None = None,
    skill: str = "",
) -> ToolResult:
    """Register an agent-produced artifact in the manifest.

    One of source_path, content, or url must be provided.  Local files are
    copied into the artifacts directory under WORKSPACE_ROOT.  Inline content
    is written directly (useful for workers running on remote machines via
    claude-pool that cannot access local paths).

    Args:
        name: Human-readable artifact name.
        type: One of chart/report/paper/data/intermediate/feishu_doc.
        description: Brief description of what this artifact contains.
        project: Project name.  None → global research scope.
        exp_id: Experiment ID.  None → project-level scope (stored under _project/).
        source_path: Local file to copy into the artifacts directory.
        content: Raw text/HTML/JSON content to write directly (alternative to source_path).
        content_filename: Filename for written content (default: "{name}.txt").
        url: External URL instead of a local file (e.g. Feishu doc).
        tags: Optional tags for filtering.
        skill: Name of the skill that produced this artifact.

    Returns:
        ToolResult with artifact id, final path/url, and manifest location.
    """
    if type not in ARTIFACT_TYPES:
        return ToolResult(
            success=False,
            error=f"Invalid type '{type}'. Must be one of: {sorted(ARTIFACT_TYPES)}",
        )
    provided = sum(bool(x) for x in [source_path, content, url])
    if provided == 0:
        return ToolResult(success=False, error="One of source_path, content, or url must be provided.")
    if provided > 1:
        return ToolResult(success=False, error="Provide only one of source_path, content, or url.")

    artifact_id = _new_id()
    created_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    rel_path: str | None = None

    if source_path:
        src = Path(source_path).expanduser().resolve()
        if not src.exists():
            return ToolResult(success=False, error=f"source_path not found: {source_path}")

        dest_dir = _artifact_dir(project, exp_id, type)
        dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest = dest_dir / src.name
        # Avoid overwriting: append short artifact ID suffix if name collides
